title: Trending Markets

edits.reason: Lesson bullet: 'Higher Lows in an uptrend often occur at previous resistance that flipped to support.' The leg-3 swing high is 94 (HH at dataIndex 9). After the 102 HH, the next Higher Low pulls back to ~97 (HL at dataIndex 17) and holds ABOVE 94 — i.e. the old 94 resistance now acts as support. Drawing this teal level on the uptrend concept chart makes the S/R-flip the bullet names visible. 94 is inside band (~74-118); teal = support per palette.

Mirror of the S/R-flip teaching for the bearish case ('The trend continues until a new S/R flip fails'). The leg-3 swing low is 102 (LL at dataIndex 9). A later Lower High forms at ~98 (LH at dataIndex 17), BELOW the old 102 low — former support now caps the rally as resistance. NOTE: auditor proposed yAxis 106, but 106 is itself an LH value (dataIndex 11), not a former-support level; corrected to 102, the actual old low that flips to resistance. 102 is inside band (~78-122); pink = resistance/sell-side per palette.

notes: Rejected the auditor's lessonChart fix (markPoint dataIndex 3 'LL' -> 'L'): the first-swing labeling is consistent authored convention across introChart (HH at idx3), lessonChart (LL at idx3) and quiz.revealMarkPoints (LL at idx3); the engine adds lead-in context so these read correctly. Changing only one slot would create inconsistency and contradict the quiz reveal. Auditor's lessonChart markLine value (106) was wrong (an LH, not a former-support low) and is corrected to 102. quiz.chart is correctly clean pre-cut (cutIndex 26) with LL/LH routed to revealMarkPoints — do not annotate pre-reveal or it spoils the answer.
